title: Help is kept as an SRS help repository (2026-10-29)

sections.name: source
sections.label: Source
sections.content: The owner, in conversation with Claude Code, 2026-10-29, while planning the third-party-ready essay editor; recorded verbatim (the owner's choice, among three options Claude Code offered for where help items are kept: an SRS help repo, one JSON file per editor, or JSON now and SRS later; the option it named was: one help repository bundled with srs-web, one container per editor and one record per feature, words edited in the editor itself).
